description: An environment's state: its live version, its addresses, its health, its services, its recent traffic; include: its live while.yaml file (while_yaml) or its known vulnerabilities and the bots seen (vulnerabilities).

include.description: An extra view on top of the state: while_yaml, or vulnerabilities.

probe.description: false: without probing (does not wake a sleeping service).

since.description: vulnerabilities: the window of bots seen in the traffic (30m, 6h, 1d…).

trial.description: The key returned by the first deploy_app (trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: get_app_status
title: Read an app's status
